summary: Frontend-only regression testing on the HTML monolithic app served at /api/app (mobile viewport 390x844). Verified the main bug fix (breakfast '🔄 Changer' button now updates menu[0].bfast) and two non-regression items (inline prefs accordion + v1.1 version). All three flows PASS — no issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: swapMeal (keto.html:10257) uses the correct key mapping: slot==='breakfast' ? 'bfast' : slot. The wrapper at line 15029 (v1.4 overlay) preserves this behaviour by delegating to the base swapMeal. Fix is applied consistently.

kpToggleInlinePrefs (keto.html:9843) reparents .prefs-modal into #prefsInlineHost and toggles the 'open' class + arrow character (›/⌄). #prefsOverlay is never opened by this function — inline accordion behaviour confirmed.

Console warnings 'FirebaseError: Missing or insufficient permissions' repeat on load (unrelated to this bug; likely LPEV Firestore rules for the anonymous guest). Consider tightening or silencing in guest mode for cleaner logs, but not a blocker for this iteration.
seed_data_creation: None — used authGuest() and generateMenu() to create in-memory menu.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a monolithic HTML file (/app/keto.html) served by FastAPI at {EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL}/api/app. Use viewport 390x844. To bypass welcome/onboarding, run in console: authGuest(); document.getElementById('obOverlay').style.display='none'; document.getElementById('kpWelcomeScreen').style.display='none'; then switchTab('plan'); generateMenu(); selectDay(0); swapMeal(0,'breakfast'|'lunch'|'dinner'). For profile prefs: switchTab('profile'); kpToggleInlinePrefs(); (or click [data-testid=profile-open-prefs]).
rca_of_issue: Original bug: swapMeal wrote to d['breakfast'] but the breakfast index is stored in d.bfast (see BFAST_RECIPES access at lines 10281,10326,10337). Fix at keto.html:10261 introduces `var key = (slot==='breakfast') ? 'bfast' : slot;` and then reads/writes d[key]. Verified: 5/5 consecutive breakfast swaps produced distinct recipe indices (60→73→52→21→33→41) and the direct UI click on the '🔄 Changer' button (onclick=swapMeal(0,'breakfast')) also advances the recipe (41→60). Lunch (3/3) and dinner (3/3) still swap correctly.

non_regression_inline_prefs_accordion.verdict: PASS — accordion opens/closes inline, prefsOverlay never opens, all 8 sections present.
